scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace web && wrangler dev --env staging
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p worker --noEmit && tsc -p worker/test --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply ageshield-db-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply ageshield-db --env production --remote
